short: Angle of 57.3°.
long: Angle of 57.3°. Complete circle includes 2π rad.

short: A frequency high enough to be radiated effi ciently as electromagnetic waves, generally above 30 kHz.
long: A frequency high enough to be radiated effi ciently as electromagnetic waves, generally above 30 kHz. Usually much higher.

short: Sawtooth waveform with linear change in V or I.
long: Sawtooth waveform with linear change in V or I.

short: Accurate, stable resistors in one leg of a Wheatstone bridge or bridge circuit in general.
long: Accurate, stable resistors in one leg of a Wheatstone bridge or bridge circuit in general. The ratio arm fraction, R1 _ R2, can be varied in most cases, typically in multiples of 10. The ratio arm fraction in a Wheatstone bridge determines two things; the placement accuracy of the measurement of an unknown resistor, Rx, and the maximum unknown resistance, Rx(max), that can be measured.

short: An application of a series RC circuit in which the output across either R or C provides a desired phase shift with respect to the input voltage.
long: An application of a series RC circuit in which the output across either R or C provides a desired phase shift with respect to the input voltage. RC phase-shifter circuits are commonly used to control the conduction time of semiconductors in power control circuits.

short: Property of L and C to oppose flow of I that is varying.
long: Property of L and C to oppose flow of I that is varying. Symbol is XC or XL. Unit is the ohm.

short: Any positive or negative number not containing j.
long: Any positive or negative number not containing j. (A 1 jB) is a complex number but A and B by themselves are real numbers.

short: The net power consumed by resistance.
long: The net power consumed by resistance. Measured in watts.

short: Same as inverse relation.
long: Same as inverse relation. As one variable increases, the other decreases.

short: A formula that states that the equivalent resistance, REQ, of a parallel circuit equals the reciprocal of the sum of the reciprocals of the individual branch resistances.
long: A formula that states that the equivalent resistance, REQ, of a parallel circuit equals the reciprocal of the sum of the reciprocals of the individual branch resistances.

short: Representation of a complex number in the form A 1 jB.
long: Representation of a complex number in the form A 1 jB.

short: The value of impedance refl ected back into the primary from the secondary.
long: The value of impedance refl ected back into the primary from the secondary.

short: The ability of a material to concentrate magnetic flux.
long: The ability of a material to concentrate magnetic flux. Mathematically, relative permeability, designated μr, is a ratio of the flux density (B) in a material such as iron to the flux density, B, in air. There are no units for μr because it is comparison of two flux densities and the units cancel.

short: A factor that indicates the ability of an insulator to concentrate electric flux, also known as the dielectric constant, K.
long: A factor that indicates the ability of an insulator to concentrate electric flux, also known as the dielectric constant, K.

short: Automatic switch operated by current in a coil.
long: Automatic switch operated by current in a coil.

short: The vibrating of relay contacts.
long: The vibrating of relay contacts.

short: Opposition to current.
long: Opposition to current. Unit is the ohm (V).

short: A conductor having a high resistance value.
long: A conductor having a high resistance value.

short: Condition of XL 5 XC in an LC circuit to favor the resonant frequency for a maximum in V, I, or Z.
long: Condition of XL 5 XC in an LC circuit to favor the resonant frequency for a maximum in V, I, or Z.

short: The frequency at which the inductive reactance, XL and the capacitive reactance, XC of an LC circuit are equal.
long: The frequency at which the inductive reactance, XL and the capacitive reactance, XC of an LC circuit are equal.

short: The polarity of voltage across a diode that prevents the diode from conducting any current.
long: The polarity of voltage across a diode that prevents the diode from conducting any current.

short: Variable resistor with two terminals to vary I.
long: Variable resistor with two terminals to vary I.

short: Ability of an LC circuit to oscillate after a sharp change in V or I.
long: Ability of an LC circuit to oscillate after a sharp change in V or I.

short: For sine-wave AC waveform, 0.707 of peak value.
long: For sine-wave AC waveform, 0.707 of peak value. Also called effective value.

short: Rotating part of generator or motor.
long: Rotating part of generator or motor.
